evidence.quote: You can use your personal API key to authenticate the request.

auth_methods.why: API key documented; every endpoint lists an OAuth 2.0 scope (e.g. freshdesk.tickets.create), so OAuth2 is supported.

evidence.quote: Freshdesk's APIs belong to the Representational State Transfer (REST) category.
Code samples for accessing the Freshdesk API in various languages including Ruby, PHP, Java, Python, and Node JS

api_surface.breadth.why: API index covers tickets, conversations, contacts, agents, companies, groups, discussions, solutions, surveys, time entries, mailboxes, settings with CRUD.

evidence.quote: Update external systems when a ticket is created ( using rules on ticket create) or when a ticket is updated

api_surface.webhooks.why: Outbound webhooks exist via automation-rule Trigger Webhook action on ticket create/update (Growth+ plans), not a subscription API.

rationale: API key (basic-auth username) plus OAuth2 scopes; broad REST API; webhooks via automation rules on paid plans.
